research.title: Sustainable Fuels Literature Review
research.description: Systematic review of the OpenAlex academic corpus focusing on sustainable fuels, their environmental impact, combustion properties, and the application of machine learning in fuel research. The pipeline filters works by keyword co-occurrence (fuel + impact terms), classifies them via OpenAI Batch API, and supports inter-rater QA.

subsets.name: Open access + LLM classified
subsets.sql: SELECT * FROM filtered_records WHERE is_oa = 1 AND llm_is_hydrocarbon IS NOT NULL

subsets.name: Open access + hydrocarbon
subsets.sql: SELECT * FROM filtered_records WHERE is_oa = 1 AND llm_is_hydrocarbon = 1

subsets.name: Open access + hydrocarbon + ML
subsets.sql: SELECT * FROM filtered_records WHERE is_oa = 1 AND llm_is_hydrocarbon = 1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(llm_ml_role) j WHERE j.value IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(CAST(j.value AS TEXT)) != '' AND LOWER(CAST(j.value AS TEXT)) NOT IN ('none'))

search.title: Publications by Year
search.sql_template: SELECT CASE WHEN publication_year IS NULL OR publication_year <= {cutoff_year} THEN 'Unknown/≤{cutoff_year}' ELSE CAST(publication_year AS TEXT) END AS year, COUNT(*) AS count FROM filtered_records GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY MIN(CASE WHEN publication_year IS NULL OR publication_year <= {cutoff_year} THEN 0 ELSE publication_year END)

search.title: Top Contributing Countries
search.sql_template: SELECT value AS country, COUNT(*) AS count FROM filtered_records, json_each(authors_countries) GROUP BY value ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT {top_n}

search.title: Top Journals / Sources
search.sql_template: SELECT primary_location_source_display_name AS journal, COUNT(*) AS count FROM filtered_records WHERE primary_location_source_display_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY journal ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT {top_n}

search.title: Open Access Status
search.sql_template: SELECT COALESCE(open_access_oa_status, 'unknown') AS status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM filtered_records GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY count DESC

search.title: Work Types
search.sql_template: SELECT COALESCE(type, 'unknown') AS type, COUNT(*) AS count FROM filtered_records GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 10

search.title: Top Institutions
search.sql_template: SELECT value AS institution, COUNT(*) AS count FROM filtered_records, json_each(authors_institutions) GROUP BY value ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT {top_n}

search.title: Fuel Subgroups
search.sql_template: SELECT REPLACE(value, 'Feedstocks and Processed', 'Feedstocks and Processes') AS subgroup, COUNT(*) AS count FROM filtered_records, json_each(matched_fuel_subgroups) WHERE matched_fuel_subgroups IS NOT NULL AND matched_fuel_subgroups != '[]' GROUP BY subgroup ORDER BY count DESC

search.title: Impact Subgroups
search.sql_template: SELECT REPLACE(value, 'Feedstocks and Processed', 'Feedstocks and Processes') AS subgroup, COUNT(*) AS count FROM filtered_records, json_each(matched_impact_subgroups) WHERE matched_impact_subgroups IS NOT NULL AND matched_impact_subgroups != '[]' GROUP BY subgroup ORDER BY count DESC

search.title: Fuel Subgroup × Impact Subgroup
search.sql_template: SELECT REPLACE(fs.value, 'Feedstocks and Processed', 'Feedstocks and Processes') AS x_label, REPLACE(isg.value, 'Feedstocks and Processed', 'Feedstocks and Processes') AS y_label, COUNT(DISTINCT openalex_id) AS count FROM filtered_records, json_each(matched_fuel_subgroups) fs, json_each(matched_impact_subgroups) isg WHERE matched_fuel_subgroups IS NOT NULL AND matched_fuel_subgroups != '[]' AND matched_impact_subgroups IS NOT NULL AND matched_impact_subgroups != '[]' GROUP BY x_label, y_label

llm.title: ML/AI Functional Role (LLM)
llm.sql_template: SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(value), ''), '(empty)') AS role, COUNT(*) AS count FROM filtered_records, json_each(llm_ml_role) GROUP BY role ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT {top_n}

llm.title: ML/AI Algorithm (LLM)
llm.sql_template: SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(value), ''), '(empty)') AS algorithm, COUNT(*) AS count FROM filtered_records, json_each(llm_ml_algorithm) GROUP BY algorithm ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT {top_n}

llm.title: ML/AI Usage Rate (LLM)
llm.sql_template: SELECT CASE WHEN llm_ml_role IS NOT NULL AND llm_ml_role NOT IN ('[]', 'null', '') AND LOWER(llm_ml_role) NOT LIKE '%"none"%' THEN 'Uses ML/AI' ELSE 'No ML/AI' END AS uses_ml, COUNT(*) AS count FROM filtered_records GROUP BY 1

llm.title: ML Data Source Distribution (LLM)
llm.sql_template: SELECT CASE WHEN llm_ml_data_source IS NULL OR TRIM(llm_ml_data_source) IN ('', 'null') THEN '(empty)' ELSE llm_ml_data_source END AS source, COUNT(*) AS count FROM filtered_records WHERE llm_ml_role IS NOT NULL AND llm_ml_role NOT IN ('[]', 'null', '') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY count DESC

llm.title: ML Role × Algorithm
llm.sql_template: SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(r.value), ''), '(empty)') AS x_label, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(a.value), ''), '(empty)') AS y_label, COUNT(DISTINCT openalex_id) AS count FROM filtered_records, json_each(llm_ml_role) r, json_each(llm_ml_algorithm) a GROUP BY x_label, y_label

llm.title: Fuel Subgroup × ML Role
llm.sql_template: SELECT REPLACE(fs.value, 'Feedstocks and Processed', 'Feedstocks and Processes') AS x_label, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(r.value), ''), '(empty)') AS y_label, COUNT(DISTINCT openalex_id) AS count FROM filtered_records, json_each(matched_fuel_subgroups) fs, json_each(llm_ml_role) r WHERE matched_fuel_subgroups IS NOT NULL AND matched_fuel_subgroups != '[]' GROUP BY x_label, y_label

llm.title: Fuel Subgroup × Algorithm
llm.sql_template: SELECT REPLACE(fs.value, 'Feedstocks and Processed', 'Feedstocks and Processes') AS x_label, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(a.value), ''), '(empty)') AS y_label, COUNT(DISTINCT openalex_id) AS count FROM filtered_records, json_each(matched_fuel_subgroups) fs, json_each(llm_ml_algorithm) a WHERE matched_fuel_subgroups IS NOT NULL AND matched_fuel_subgroups != '[]' GROUP BY x_label, y_label

llm.title: Impact Subgroup × ML Role
llm.sql_template: SELECT REPLACE(isg.value, 'Feedstocks and Processed', 'Feedstocks and Processes') AS x_label, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(r.value), ''), '(empty)') AS y_label, COUNT(DISTINCT openalex_id) AS count FROM filtered_records, json_each(matched_impact_subgroups) isg, json_each(llm_ml_role) r WHERE matched_impact_subgroups IS NOT NULL AND matched_impact_subgroups != '[]' GROUP BY x_label, y_label

llm.title: Impact Subgroup × Algorithm
llm.sql_template: SELECT REPLACE(isg.value, 'Feedstocks and Processed', 'Feedstocks and Processes') AS x_label, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(a.value), ''), '(empty)') AS y_label, COUNT(DISTINCT openalex_id) AS count FROM filtered_records, json_each(matched_impact_subgroups) isg, json_each(llm_ml_algorithm) a WHERE matched_impact_subgroups IS NOT NULL AND matched_impact_subgroups != '[]' GROUP BY x_label, y_label

llm.title: Fuel × Impact Subgroup (ML/AI Papers Only)
llm.sql_template: SELECT REPLACE(fs.value, 'Feedstocks and Processed', 'Feedstocks and Processes') AS x_label, REPLACE(isg.value, 'Feedstocks and Processed', 'Feedstocks and Processes') AS y_label, COUNT(DISTINCT openalex_id) AS count FROM filtered_records, json_each(matched_fuel_subgroups) fs, json_each(matched_impact_subgroups) isg WHERE matched_fuel_subgroups IS NOT NULL AND matched_fuel_subgroups != '[]' AND matched_impact_subgroups IS NOT NULL AND matched_impact_subgroups != '[]' AND llm_ml_role IS NOT NULL AND llm_ml_role NOT IN ('[]', 'null', '') AND LOWER(llm_ml_role) NOT LIKE '%"none"%' GROUP BY x_label, y_label

llm.title: Research Objective (LLM)
llm.sql_template: SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(value), ''), '(empty)') AS objective, COUNT(*) AS count FROM filtered_records, json_each(llm_research_objective) WHERE llm_research_objective IS NOT NULL AND llm_research_objective != '[]' GROUP BY objective ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT {top_n}

llm.title: Research Objective × ML Role
llm.sql_template: SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(o.value), ''), '(empty)') AS x_label, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(r.value), ''), '(empty)') AS y_label, COUNT(DISTINCT openalex_id) AS count FROM filtered_records, json_each(llm_research_objective) o, json_each(llm_ml_role) r WHERE llm_research_objective IS NOT NULL AND llm_research_objective != '[]' GROUP BY x_label, y_label

llm.title: Research Objective × Algorithm
llm.sql_template: SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(o.value), ''), '(empty)') AS x_label, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(a.value), ''), '(empty)') AS y_label, COUNT(DISTINCT openalex_id) AS count FROM filtered_records, json_each(llm_research_objective) o, json_each(llm_ml_algorithm) a WHERE llm_research_objective IS NOT NULL AND llm_research_objective != '[]' GROUP BY x_label, y_label

llm.title: Research Objective × ML Data Source
llm.sql_template: SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(o.value), ''), '(empty)') AS x_label, CASE WHEN llm_ml_data_source IS NULL OR TRIM(llm_ml_data_source) IN ('', 'null') THEN '(empty)' ELSE llm_ml_data_source END AS y_label, COUNT(DISTINCT openalex_id) AS count FROM filtered_records, json_each(llm_research_objective) o WHERE llm_research_objective IS NOT NULL AND llm_research_objective != '[]' GROUP BY x_label, y_label

llm.title: Fuel Subgroup × Research Objective
llm.sql_template: SELECT REPLACE(fs.value, 'Feedstocks and Processed', 'Feedstocks and Processes') AS x_label, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(o.value), ''), '(empty)') AS y_label, COUNT(DISTINCT openalex_id) AS count FROM filtered_records, json_each(matched_fuel_subgroups) fs, json_each(llm_research_objective) o WHERE matched_fuel_subgroups IS NOT NULL AND matched_fuel_subgroups != '[]' AND llm_research_objective IS NOT NULL AND llm_research_objective != '[]' GROUP BY x_label, y_label

llm.title: Impact Subgroup × Research Objective
llm.sql_template: SELECT REPLACE(isg.value, 'Feedstocks and Processed', 'Feedstocks and Processes') AS x_label, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(o.value), ''), '(empty)') AS y_label, COUNT(DISTINCT openalex_id) AS count FROM filtered_records, json_each(matched_impact_subgroups) isg, json_each(llm_research_objective) o WHERE matched_impact_subgroups IS NOT NULL AND matched_impact_subgroups != '[]' AND llm_research_objective IS NOT NULL AND llm_research_objective != '[]' GROUP BY x_label, y_label

openalex_id.description: Unique OpenAlex work identifier (e.g. W1234567890), used as primary key

doi.description: Digital Object Identifier for the work

is_oa.description: Whether the work is open access (1=yes, 0=no)

abstract_text.description: Reconstructed abstract text from OpenAlex inverted index

publication_date.description: Full publication date as ISO string

language.description: Language of the work (always 'en' due to pre-filter)

open_access_any_repository_has_fulltext.description: Whether any repository hosts the full text

open_access_oa_status.description: OA status: gold, green, hybrid, bronze, closed

open_access_oa_url.description: Best open-access URL for the work

primary_location_is_oa.description: Whether the primary location is open access

primary_location_landing_page_url.description: Landing page URL at the primary source

primary_location_license.description: License at the primary location (e.g. cc-by)

primary_location_source_display_name.description: Journal or source name where the work is published

primary_location_source_type.description: Source type: journal, repository, conference, etc.

has_fulltext.description: Whether OpenAlex has indexed the full text

best_oa_location_license.description: License at the best open-access location

best_oa_location_pdf_url.description: Direct PDF URL at the best OA location

best_oa_location_version.description: Version at the best OA location (publishedVersion, acceptedVersion, etc.)

authors_institutions.description: JSON array of objects with author names and their institution affiliations

authors_countries.description: JSON array of country codes extracted from author affiliations

matched_fuel_terms.description: JSON array of fuel keyword terms that matched in title/abstract

matched_impact_terms.description: JSON array of impact keyword terms that matched in title/abstract

matched_fuel_stems.description: JSON array of stemmed fuel terms that matched

matched_impact_stems.description: JSON array of stemmed impact terms that matched

matched_fuel_subgroups.description: JSON array of fuel keyword subgroup names that matched (e.g. ["Diesel & HVO", "Jet Fuels & SAF"])

matched_impact_subgroups.description: JSON array of impact keyword subgroup names that matched (e.g. ["GHG & Carbon", "Engine Performance"])

cited_by_count.description: Number of citations according to OpenAlex

primary_location_source_issn_l.description: Linking ISSN of the primary source journal

is_retracted.description: Whether the work has been retracted (1=yes, 0=no)

llm_is_hydrocarbon.description: LLM classification: whether the work is relevant to hydrocarbon fuels (1=yes, 0=no)

llm_ml_role.description: JSON array of ML/AI functional roles (e.g. ["prediction"], ["optimization"])

llm_ml_algorithm.description: JSON array of ML model names extracted from abstract (e.g. ["ANN", "Genetic Algorithm"])

llm_ml_data_source.description: Single string: primary data source type used by ML models in the work

llm_confidence.description: LLM self-reported confidence level for the classification

llm_justification.description: LLM explanation for its classification decisions

llm_result_raw.description: Raw LLM output text (fallback when JSON parsing fails)

llm_batch_id.description: OpenAI batch job ID that produced this classification

llm_processed_at.description: ISO timestamp when LLM classification was saved

llm_tokens_input.description: Number of input tokens consumed for this work's classification

llm_tokens_output.description: Number of output tokens generated for this work's classification

llm_tokens_reasoning.description: Number of reasoning tokens used (for reasoning models)
